content: Ahimsa pratishtayam tat sannidhau vaira tyagah. (When one is firmly established in non-violence, all hostility ceases in their presence).
author: Patanjali
explanation: When harmlessness (*Ahimsa*) becomes absolute in thought, word, and deed, it radiates a palpable aura of peace that dissolves antagonism in the surrounding environment.
practicalInsight: Refrain from any internal judgment, sharp sarcasm, or aggressive impatience today. Respond with unwavering calm and goodwill.
reflectionPrompt: How can I eliminate subtle violence in my internal self-talk and daily speech?
